ultimate_flowstate.name: Flowstate
ultimate_flowstate.note: At full stacks: +1/+2/+3 Mining Speed per block in a row, capped at 200 blocks (200/400/600). Less while the streak is short.

efficiency.name: Efficiency
efficiency.note: Levels VI to X come from one Silex each on a tool that has Efficiency V; there are no books for them.
